content.what_it_is: Conditional VESSEL_MODULE (L53-L960) models moving ship-wake sources. VESSEL_INITIAL (L122-L456) reads global switches, allocates per-vessel/grid state, opens vessel_##### files, reads source type/shape/path records, and derives optional propeller quantities. VESSEL_FORCING (L458-L634) advances paths, interpolates positions, accumulates pressure, slender-body, or Green-function sources, forms pressure gradients, deep-draft masks/friction/viscosity, and optional propeller velocity. PRESSURE_SOURCE (L636-L796), GREEN_FUNCTION_SOURCE (L798-L885), and SLENDER_BODY_SOURCE (L888-L956) implement the three spatial source formulations.

unresolved: Use-before-assign on missing NumVessel: READ_INTEGER at L149 has no ierr/default branch, but NumVessel is immediately used as every allocation extent at L263-L285 and as the loop bound at L312. A missing or invalid key leaves the module integer without a defined value before allocation.

Source/propeller interface mismatch: propeller inputs are read only inside the PR source branch at L352-L360, but E0, Veff, Cf, and IZEF are computed unconditionally for every vessel under PROPELLER at L445-L450. SL or PA vessels therefore use unassigned N_revolution, D_prop, C_thrust, D_hub, BAR, H_prop, and C_duct.

PA initialization mismatch: geometry/source parameters are read for PR at L352-L381 and SL at L383-L388, with no PA branch before the path read at L389-L390; VESSEL_FORCING nevertheless dispatches PA to GREEN_FUNCTION_SOURCE at L552-L555, which uses LengthVessel, WidthVessel, Pvessel and related state at L827-L875. Those values are unassigned for PA as parsed here.

REALISTIC_VESSEL_BODY compile-path defects: executable assignment L806 precedes conditional declarations L809-L812; L835 has unmatched parentheses; Xco and Yco are indexed as rank-2 at L837 although all other uses are Xco(I),Yco(J); Z_prime is used as a whole array in scalar r3/r3_2m/r3_4m expressions at L837 and L843-L845; W_farfield is assigned as a whole array at L831-L835 and then used in scalar assignment L851-L852; L851-L852 also lacks an arithmetic operator between the two parenthesized velocity terms. This conditional branch is not a type/rank/syntax-consistent Fortran implementation.

Propeller and shape singularities are not range-checked: L446-L450 divide by D_hub, H_prop and C_duct, raise C_thrust to a negative power and take SQRT(C_thrust); L726-L729 divide by D_prop, C_thrust and ABS(Lrear); pressure/slender formulas divide by LengthVessel and WidthVessel at L713-L716 and L873-L875/L911-L934. Zero or nonpositive vessel-file values can produce division by zero or invalid real powers.

EOF behavior: the path READ at L485 jumps to label 120 at L560, after all source dispatches. Once a vessel path reaches EOF, that vessel contributes no pressure/flux for that call and subsequent calls that again enter the read condition, rather than holding its last position; the intended post-track lifetime is not stated in this file.

Unknown SourceType is not rejected after L349. It bypasses all geometry reads at L352-L388 and all forcing dispatches at L531-L557, while diagnostics at L403-L419 still read and print uninitialized geometry arrays.

The realistic far-field selection requires both ABS(Lves)>=Length and ABS(Wves)>=Width at L827-L828. Points outside only one side of the rectangle are excluded although comments L823-L825 describe the far field as outside the rectangle; whether AND should be OR is unresolved from this file.
